len_str = len(str)
at_replaced = 0

    if i == 0 and str.startswith("at", i):
        result += "at"
        i += 2
    elif i == 0 and str.startswith("dot", i):
        result += "dot"
        i += 3
    elif i == len_str - 2 and str.startswith("at", i):
        result += "at"
        break
    elif i == len_str - 3 and str.startswith("dot", i):
        result += "dot"
        break
    elif str.startswith("at", i) and at_replaced == 0:
        result += "@"
        at_replaced = 1
        i += 2
    elif str.startswith("dot", i):
        result += "."
        i += 3
    else:
        result += str[i]
        i += 1

print(result)
